t: The Spa Single Voltage LED Shaver Light provides robust and adaptable illumination for bathroom installations in both domestic and commercial settings. This durable fixture, with sleek finish and polycarbonate body, delivers 1000 lumens of efficient light output from just 10W. This IP44 rated unit is suitable for Bathroom Zone 2, offering protection against splashes. Users can select from warm white, cool white, or daylight colour temperature and utilise the dimmable functionality for desired brightness. A built-in illuminated push-button switch, and a discreet charging socket (for shaver or electric toothbrush), enhance convenience and functionality for any modern bathroom project.
